answer: Same model behind 100 keys is still one model. Fingerprint the output distribution per key, compare against the fleet, and flag any pair above 0.9 similarity. Example: 8 keys sharing a tokenizer quirk get flagged in one epoch and re-queued to a second panel across unrelated subnets. A farm can rent 100 keys but not 100 different models, so the variation it needs is expensive. One bridge of shared fingerprints closes the inlet, and the orchard of clones stops fruiting.
